use_case: Transaction fraud-detection model scoring every authorization (approve, step-up, review, or decline bands)
business_owner: Head of merchant risk and fraud
vendor_or_model: In-house machine learning model, retrained monthly on tokenized data in SYS-G4; validated by model risk management
data_categories: Tokens (never PAN), amount, merchant category, BIN country, card type, billing ZIP code, device and IP signals for card-not-present
consequential_decision_category: Safety/CI (inline on payment infrastructure); not a credit decision
human_in_the_loop: No human before an automatic decline (real time); analysts review step-up and review bands; monthly sample of 300 automatic declines; merchants can dispute declines
applicable_laws: FTC Act 15 U.S.C. 45(a), 45(n); 16 CFR 314.4(c); PCI DSS 3.2.1 (training data tokens only); card brand rules; Colorado SB26-189 (counsel reviewing whether a purchase decline is a consequential decision); CCPA ADMT rules not expected to reach GLBA data (Cal. Civ. Code 1798.145(e); counsel confirms)

use_case: Merchant underwriting and risk model scoring new merchant applications and setting reserve recommendations
business_owner: Head of merchant risk and fraud
data_categories: Merchant owner identity and credit bureau attributes, business type, processing history, bank account data
consequential_decision_category: Credit (conservative; counsel reviewing whether a merchant processing agreement is credit under ECOA and Regulation B)
human_in_the_loop: Model approves low-risk applications inside policy cutoffs (about 55%); underwriters decide every decline and every reserve above policy
applicable_laws: FTC Act 15 U.S.C. 45; ECOA and Regulation B, 12 CFR Part 1002 (applicability under counsel review); Colorado SB26-189 (financial or lending services, under review for sole proprietors); 16 CFR 314.4(c)

use_case: Dispute evidence classifier recommending whether to accept or fight a chargeback
data_categories: Dispute case data and documents (masked PAN after POAM-007)
human_in_the_loop: Dispute analysts (processor and Merchant Consulting) decide every case
applicable_laws: Card network dispute rules (contract); FTC Act 15 U.S.C. 45(a); PCI DSS 3.2.1

use_case: Merchant insights assistant: generative answers about a merchant's own sales and orders in the commerce software
vendor_or_model: Hosted large language model from a third-party model provider (zero-retention terms) with retrieval from the merchant's own data
data_categories: Merchant sales and order data, including merchants' customers' names and email addresses; no PAN
human_in_the_loop: Merchants read and act on answers; outputs labeled AI-generated with links to source reports
applicable_laws: FTC Act 15 U.S.C. 45(a) (claims); 16 CFR 314.4(f) (model provider); SOC 2 commitments (CC2.3, CC8.1, CC9.2); CCPA service provider terms (under counsel review); N51-R04 (28 CFR 202 screening of the model provider)
status: In production for about 58,000 merchants; new enrollments paused until conditions are met

use_case: Gateway card-testing and API abuse detection
data_categories: API call patterns, key identifiers, tokens, decline codes
consequential_decision_category: None (security decision); re-tier if it starts declining individual purchases
human_in_the_loop: Automatic throttling of keys; analysts confirm before a key is revoked

use_case: Coding assistant for Payment Processing and Software division engineers
data_categories: Source code; no cardholder or customer data permitted
human_in_the_loop: Engineers review all suggestions; normal code review and testing apply
applicable_laws: Contract terms; POL-04 4.9; PCI DSS 6.2 (secure development)

use_case: Generative AI use by Merchant Consulting staff for client deliverables
vendor_or_model: Today: public chatbots (prohibited); target: the group enterprise assistant
data_categories: Client documents and data (prohibited in public tools)
human_in_the_loop: Consultants review all outputs; engagement leads approve client deliverables
applicable_laws: Engagement letters (contract); 16 CFR 314.4(e) and (f)(2) (contract flow-down); PCI DSS 3.2.1; FTC Act 15 U.S.C. 45(a)
status: Public chatbots blocked by 2026-11-30; approved tool rollout (POAM-022)

use_case: Merchant support virtual agent answering portal and funding questions with handoff to staff
vendor_or_model: Customer service platform with a hosted language model (no-training terms)
data_categories: Merchant account and funding status; no PAN
human_in_the_loop: Handoff to a person on request or when the agent is unsure; agent cannot change funding accounts or refunds
applicable_laws: FTC Act 15 U.S.C. 45(a); 16 CFR 314.4(f); disclosure of AI interaction (Group AI Standard)

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant for the workforce (drafting, summarizing internal documents)
vendor_or_model: Enterprise AI assistant with no-training and retention terms
data_categories: Internal documents; Restricted data prohibited except approved roles in the enterprise tenant
human_in_the_loop: Users review outputs; prohibited for decisions about cardholders, merchants, or clients
